assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original seamless diffuse albedo ground texture for realistic miniature volcanic terrain. Strict vertical overhead orthographic macro photograph of a 40 centimetre square surface, edge to edge, evenly lit with neutral diffuse light. No directional shadows, reflections, highlights, vignette, perspective, depth of field, text, grid or objects. Fine natural irregular detail, tileable edges, no obvious repeated motif. Dry wind-settled volcanic ash and fine mineral dust. Subtle smooth charcoal-grey and warm neutral grey layers, shallow irregular erosion rills, scattered very small dark cinders. Mostly fine dusty ground with quiet broad areas. No dunes, no large rocks, no footprints, no bright patches, no molten lava, no glowing cracks. Natural soft variation within medium-dark grey, enough visible microtexture for daylight.
assets.processing: Original 1024-square PNG converted to WebP quality90; mipmaps generated by existing reference texture loader; albedo-derived relief only.
